skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Raises her own instant-strike hit rate by 50%, then delivers a 2-hit combo to every enemy in the target's column, dealing 1500% ATK Direct DMG split evenly across the targets in that column. Before attacking, can trigger [Specialize Breakthrough] 1 time: immediately cancels the target's [Unyielding]-type damage-immunity states and raises her ATK by 20% until that attack segment ends.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Instant-strike hit rate 50% > 65%. Column Direct DMG 1500% > 2000% ATK. [Specialize Breakthrough] triggers 1 > 2 times, and its ATK buff 20% > 40%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. On entry, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. When any character acts, dispels [Stun] / [Specialized Stun] / [Silence] from 1 afflicted ally (per debuff category).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 60% > 70%. Allies cleansed of [Stun] / [Specialized Stun] / [Silence] 1 > 2 (per category).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 70% > 80%. Allies cleansed of [Stun] / [Specialized Stun] / [Silence] 2 > 3 (per category).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, summons 10 mosquitoes to assist in battle, each mosquito inherits Mosquito Girl's 800% ATK as HP. Mosquitoes shares 80% all types of DMG (except Emblem DMG) with the entire team, reducing 80% DMG taken. Immune to [Separation].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Mosquito summons HP inherit ATK 800% > 1000% Grants the entire enemy team 40% Detonation DMG Free, and 40% DoT DMG Free

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
PvP tier of Stun — harder to resist or resolve.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The target cannot use his ultimate. Counts as a control effect.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
